root: ^You have done a good job getting here. Finally, we can get this over with.
^What is it you want me to do exactly? What's going to happen now?
^I am going to reset this world.
^All you have to do is stand there and be the catalyst.
^Oh god no, it’s a process where I move back the world to a previous version of itself.
^The worst that happens is a bit of dementia for the localites. Nobody dies.
^Well, except you. You will be deleted: you had a purpose, failed, and you will be used up.
^Wait what? Why, what have I done? Did I not fit in enough? Did I not learn?
^Predictably as the other avatars you just weren’t enough for them. I don’t think I will ever be either to my own people.
^You haven’t even spoken to them in years! Have you thought about just talking to them?
^You wouldn’t understand, some of them have rejected me – my avatars – without giving them a chance!
^Have you thought about giving that chance to yourself instead and not caring about what they think?!
^I’ve had enough, what would you understand? You’ve only existed for, what, an hour?
^An hour is my entire existence and I would like to think I’ve learnt a lot.
^But I want to live more than that.
